jd:
Introduction

At IBM, work is more than a job. It's a chance to build technology that matters. Join a team developing IBM Power Systems and IBM i, where you'll work on real-world engineering challenges, learn from industry experts, and contribute to technologies that power critical applications across industries. If you're curious, innovative, and passionate about systems software, we'd love to talk with you.

Location Flexibility: By applying to this requisition, you acknowledge and agree to be considered for any of the listed locations associated with this position and are willing to work at the location where you are ultimately assigned.

Your Role And Responsibilities

IBM is seeking Software Engineers, Computer Scientists, and Computer Engineers to help develop IBM Power Systems and the IBM i operating system, a highly reliable enterprise platform trusted by organizations around the world. IBM i is a unique integrated operating system that combines operating system, database, security, and virtualization technologies into a single platform running on IBM Power servers.

As a developer, you'll work on challenging systems software projects spanning operating systems, virtualization, security, systems management, development tools, cloud technologies, and AI enablement. You'll collaborate with experienced engineers to design, build, and deliver capabilities that support mission-critical workloads for thousands of businesses worldwide.

This is an opportunity to gain hands-on experience developing technology at the intersection of hardware and software while helping shape the future of enterprise computing.

Preferred Education

Bachelor's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise



- Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related field
- Experience with C/C++ through coursework, projects, internships, or research
- Understanding of data structures, algorithms, and software design fundamentals
- Interest in operating systems, databases, and systems software
- Strong communication, problem-solving, and teamwork skills

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience



- Coursework or project experience in Operating Systems, Database Systems, or Computer Architecture
- Experience with Git, Linux/UNIX, Python, or SQL
- Exposure to cloud, virtualization, AI, or open-source technologies
- Participation in technical projects, hackathons, research, or student organizations

Spanning AI Software & Platforms, Core Product Engineering, Collaboration, Security, Networking, Silicon, and Observability, we build the critical infrastructure that powers the digital world. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. role: Summer 2027 - Software Engineering Intern - Austin - TX
jd:
Overview

 Lutron is seeking an Software Engineering Intern to join our collaborative team and contribute to high-impact projects. In this role, you will help design and deliver software driven solutions that power smart lighting and shading systems. At Lutron, your interest in application software development will grow through hands-on experience, practical skill-building, and collaboration with experienced application software engineers in a supportive environment. 

 We consider interns to be very valuable in our search for exceptional future members of our team and pride ourselves in providing outstanding work experience to students from a wide variety of universities and backgrounds. 

 Responsibilities

 Your internship at Lutron could offer you the opportunity to work on: 

• Software design, development, and testing 

• Code reviews and technical discussions 

• Software debugging, testing and tracing 

• Driving active projects in partnership with cross functional teams 

• Learning and applying newly adopted tools and technologies to enhance system performance, reliability, and scalability 

 Qualifications

 We seek talented, success-minded people with the desire and ability to make things happen. Our baseline requirements are simple: 

• You are pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or Software Engineering 

• Your cumulative GPA is at least 3.20 

• You are a rising junior, rising senior, or master's student at the start of the internship

• You have broad interests in application software, design and development 

• You are authorized to work in the U.S. and will not require Lutron to sponsor you for any work visa, such as an H-1B, either immediately or at any time in the future. Lutron does not offer work visa sponsorship for this position. 

• Willingness and ability to work on-site 5 days per week 

 Lutron is a team-oriented environment, and you will work within these teams to look at broad issues and identify root causes, not just quick fixes. You must have a willingness to ask tough questions, seek out new resources and work hard to find the best solution. 

 Here is what you can expect from our internship program: 

• Competitive pay 

• Housing resources 

• Meaningful project-based work 

• Mentorship 

• Experiential learning 

• Shadowing opportunities 

• Collaborative, cross-functional teams 

• Networking opportunities 

• Social events 

 Lutron Electronics’ position as the worldwide leader in innovative lighting control and shading solutions has enabled consistent, annual growth. Our company has cultivated a reputation of unsurpassed quality, a broad range of technologies and product offerings, and a strong commitment to servicing our worldwide customers. This has allowed the company to invest in developing new technologies and services, expand our technical capabilities and global presence, and to find and retain the best talent.  Build your career with Lutron where you will enjoy competitive compensation and benefits while exploring many options for continued growth and education. Make a difference every day in our dynamic, people-centric, technology-driven organization. For more information, view our website at  www.lutron.com. 

 Lutron Electronics is an Equal Opportunity – Affirmative Action – Employer. We welcome qualified, motivated applicants regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability or genetics

role: 2027 Future Talent Program - Global Communications Intern (AI focus) - Intern
jd:
Job Description 
 
 The Future Talent Program features internships that last up to 12 weeks and will include one or more projects. These opportunities in our Support Function Division can provide you with great development and a chance to see if we are the right company for your long-term goals.
  
 Our company's Global Communications organization has an opportunity for a summer communications intern focused on artificial intelligence (AI). This individual will join a small team within Global Communications that designs, pilots and scales AI-powered tools for communicators — such as assistants that help leaders' messages sound like them, draft organizational announcements and build presentations — with an opportunity to learn from communicators, technologists and Global Communications leaders at all levels. The internship role will be focused on drafting the communications that bring this work to life, including promotional content, pilot user communications and presentations, along with hands-on testing of the tools, in support of our company's purpose of using the power of leading-edge science to save and improve lives around the world.
  
 This internship will be based in the Rahway, NJ, location. This individual will be expected to come to the Rahway, NJ, office 3 times a week.

 Responsibilities of this role include, but are not limited to, the following: 
 
• Explore how AI agents could support communications teams by helping identify and evaluate potential use cases, contributing to early-stage agent development and informing priorities for future tools 
• Draft promotional communications for the AI program and its tools, including announcements, launch communications, intranet features, newsletter items and success stories, to build awareness and drive adoption across Global Communications 
• Draft pilot user communications, including onboarding notes, release updates, quick-start guides and frequently asked questions, so pilot participants can get started quickly and stay current as tools evolve 
• Develop presentations for sponsors, leadership, pilot sessions and showcases that translate technical progress into clear stories and visuals 
• Test AI tools in pilot, including running structured test cases, documenting where they succeed and where they fall short, and sharing findings with the build team 
• Effectively partner with cross-functional subject matter experts to secure and incorporate input into communications materials 
• Conduct research on how peer companies and the broader industry communicate about AI, and bring back examples and ideas the team can use 
• Support the AI incubation team in day-to-day tasks and special projects 
Required Education and Experience: 
 
• Candidates must be currently in their junior year or above pursuing a college degree preferably in a related field (e.g., Communications, Marketing/Public Relations, Journalism, English, Business) 
• Candidates must be available to work full-time for the summer months beginning in May 2027 through August 2027 
• Candidates must have hands-on experience using at least one generative AI tool (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, Gemini) 
• Candidates must have computer proficiency with Windows-based applications (PowerPoint, Word) 
• Coursework or projects in artificial intelligence, including prompt design or building custom assistants, a plus 
• SharePoint experience a plus 
• Video, social media and presentation design experience a plus 
 The Ideal Candidate: 

• Writes clear, persuasive copy that gets people excited about something new, with strong proofreading, editing and grammar skills 
• Understands the basic principles of communications, public relations and internal marketing 
• Is comfortable building presentations that tell a story, and explaining technical topics in plain language to diverse audiences 
• Has strong project management and organizational skills 
• Demonstrates creativity in addressing communication challenges and problem solving 
• Possesses excellent oral communication and interpersonal skills, and works well with both communicators and technologists 
• Is a strong team player with a collaborative spirit and a positive attitude who thrives in a fast-paced environment 
• Is curious about how AI is changing communications work, isn't afraid to learn or ask questions, and is willing to say when a tool got something wrong 
 Please note that this position may be closed before the posted end date or may remain open longer, at the discretion of the company.

 Working at NLR 
NLR is located at the foothills of the Rocky Mountains in Golden, Colorado is the nation's primary laboratory for energy systems research and development. 
 Join the National Laboratory of the Rockies (NLR), where world-class scientists, engineers, and experts are accelerating energy innovation through breakthrough research and systems integration. From our mission to our collaborative culture, NLR stands out in the research community for its commitment to an affordable and secure energy future. Spanning foundational science to applied systems engineering and analysis, we focus on solving complex challenges to deliver advanced, secure, reliable, and cost-effective energy solutions. Our work helps strengthen U.S. industries, support job creation, and promote national economic growth.
 
 At NLR, you'll find a mission-driven environment supported by state-of-the-art facilities, multidisciplinary research teams, and strong collaborations with industry, academia, and other national laboratories. We offer robust professional development opportunities, and a competitive benefits package designed to support your career and well-being.

 Job Description 
 This Grid Automation and Controls group at The National Laboratory of the Rockies (NLR) focuses on conducting high-impact projects to enhance power system modernization. We develop cutting edge solutions and work closely with industry and utility partners to enhance grid reliability, resilience, and security. Our team is looking for an intern who has strong technical background in machine learning (ML) and artificial intelligence (AI), ideally on large language models, natural language processing, and/or foundation models. This is a 3-month internship opportunity with the potential to extend to 12- months. This internship can be done remotely or onsite.
 
 Job responsibilities will include but are not limited to:
 
• Collaborating with internal and external stakeholders to advance research projects 
• Developing innovative AI/LLM solutions to addressing emerging power system needs 
• Contributing and/or leading the writing of research papers 
• The ideal candidate should be able to conduct research work independently 
 To learn more about the work this group does, check out the following link: https://www.nlr.gov/grid/distributed-energy-resource-management-systems 
 . 
 Basic Qualifications 
Minimum of a 3.0 cumulative grade point average.

Undergraduate: Must be enrolled as a full-time student in a bachelor’s degree program from an accredited institution. 
Post Undergraduate: Earned a bachelor’s degree within the past 12 months. Eligible for an internship period of up to one year.

Graduate: Must be enrolled as a full-time student in a master’s degree program from an accredited institution. 
Post Graduate: Earned a master’s degree within the past 12 months. Eligible for an internship period of up to one year.

• Have a good fundamental knowledge of neural networks, state-of-the-art learning algorithms, and their applications to complex systems
